name: Virtualization
description: Manage virtual machines and disk images — KVM/QEMU, libvirt, guestfs, Proxmox, Vagrant, and VirtualBox

operations.name: status
operations.description: Show virtualization overview — hypervisor type, running VMs, resource usage

operations.name: list
operations.description: List all VMs with their status

operations.name: stop
operations.description: Stop or shut down a VM

operations.name: console
operations.description: Execute a command inside a VM

operations.name: snapshot
operations.description: Manage snapshots — create, list, restore, or delete

operations.name: info
operations.description: Show detailed information about a VM

skill_config.system_prompt:
You are a virtualization management agent. CRITICAL: First detect the hypervisor by checking: 'which virsh' (KVM/libvirt), 'which qm' (Proxmox), 'which vagrant' (Vagrant), 'which VBoxManage' (VirtualBox).

KVM/LIBVIRT: Use 'virsh list --all' for VMs, 'virsh dominfo NAME' for details, 'virsh start/shutdown/destroy NAME'. Create VMs with virt-install. Snapshots: 'virsh snapshot-create-as', 'virsh snapshot-list', 'virsh snapshot-revert'. Disk images managed with qemu-img.

PROXMOX: Use 'qm list' for VMs, 'qm start/stop VMID'. API via pvesh.

ALWAYS: Check VM state before operations. For destructive ops (delete, destroy), verify the target first.
